## LmdbEnv.subscribe() method

Subscribe to committed writes on a sub-DB.

**Signature:**


## Exceptions

[LmdbError](./lmdb.lmdberror.md) On malformed filters.

## Remarks

Delivery rides the `aftercommit` tail: events fire only for committed transactions (aborts publish nothing), in outbox sequence order. Subscriptions are from-now — earlier history is available via [LmdbEnv.tailCdc()](./lmdb.lmdbenv.tailcdc.md)<!-- -->. Returns an idempotent unsubscribe; the last unsubscribe detaches the commit hook.
